items.title: Scallop Arch DXF Screen for Coastal Fence Panels
items.description: Rows of tightly packed arched scallops stack from top to bottom, forming a fish-scale rhythm across the full panel. The dense, uniform curves suit coastal fence panels, spa entrances, and screens with a soft repeating texture.

items.title: Crescent Moroccan Star Slatted DXF Screen for CNC Doors
items.description: Download this free half-moon medallion built from nested eight-point Moroccan stars, sitting centered over a rhythm of horizontal slats. The slats keep most of the panel airy and low-detail, letting the star medallion read as the clear focal point from a distance, perfect for gates that need both privacy and visual interest.
